grammar_errors.mistake: He offered plain 'big' for 'the most weight'; Amal said لا and gave the comparative أكبر/أكتر وزن.
grammar_errors.fix: بس، لا، we would need biggest. So, would be أكبر، أكبر وزن. ... we can use أكثر ... أكثر وزن.

grammar_errors.mistake: Two hundred is the dual of مية (ميتين); Amal said No and walked him to the dual, which he then produced.
grammar_errors.said: Is it مي- uh, مئين؟ مئين؟ مئين؟
grammar_errors.fix: No. ميا. Let's go to ميا first. Is ميا feminine؟ ... So what do we do to dual form؟

grammar_errors.mistake: حركة is feminine so the number-adjective must be واحدة; Amal recast it.
After بعد the verb needs ما and drops the b-; Amal prompted and he said ما أحمل.
grammar_errors.fix: بعد. What do we put after بعد؟ ... ما.

grammar_errors.mistake: Wrong plural pattern for شغل; Amal said No and accepted أشغال.

grammar_errors.mistake: مهندس is masculine so واحد; Amal recast twice.
'The other one' needs el-; Amal prompted with 'the' and he said التاني.
'The last one' takes no el- after آخر; Amal said we never put ل and gave آخر واحد.
grammar_errors.fix: Where do I put the ل؟ Actually we never put ل. آخر واحد.

grammar_errors.mistake: He is naming the last uncle (masculine) and said واحدة; Amal's recast is آخر واحد, and he repeated واحدة at 32:51 before fixing it himself.

grammar_errors.fix: خلاص بس بس uncle يعني. خمس بنات عم. ... We're not saying my.

grammar_errors.mistake: After 'وتسع' (nine, 40:00) he used singular ابن; a 3-10 count needs the plural, and Amal said No, the plural is ولاد عم (one = ابن عم).

not_errors.why: 'Between twenty and seventeen' makes no sense for an age band; Amal questioned it and supplied تلاتين, which he repeated.

not_errors.label: Wrong word
not_errors.why: Asked who studies, he said teacher; Amal: who teaches? the teacher - and he gave طالب وطلاب.
not_errors.verdict_reason: Amal asked «مين بيدرس في الجامعة أو مدرسة؟»; بيدرس also reads 'teaches', and «معلم؟» (teacher) is right for that - her «المعلم، مين بيعلم؟» agrees. Once it was clear he said «طالب وطلاب» himself: طالب was not missed.
